title: Propagation sidecar
description: Schema for .propagates.yml sidecars. Each sidecar covers the docs/CLAUDE.mds in its directory and declares where edits propagate.

workspace.description: This dir is a ledger-owning workspace root, not just an edge sidecar.

path.description: Relative path from this sidecar to the downstream file. May be a glob (e.g. `style/pages/**/*.md`) — the watcher fs-expands it and records a single summary entry {glob_matched, sample}; `doctor` requires ≥1 match.

why.description: Short reason this downstream depends on the source.

concepts.description: Forward-compat: per-section concept tags for graph-augment (V2). Keys are section anchors; values are concept candidate lists.
